PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Name: Quickhack
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.JackInDescription: Quickhacking controls. Equip this item to Jack In to a targeted character or perform a Quickhack from the Fight tab.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Created: Pneuma's Quickhack Items are installed in the Items directory.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.impair-move: Reduces the target's MOVE by 1 for 60 seconds.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.sonic-shock: Temporarily deafens the target and gives them the Damaged Ear Critical Injury without its bonus damage.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.overheat: Sets the target on fire, dealing 4 direct HP damage after each of their Turns until extinguished.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.short-circu: Disables three eligible pieces of the target's cyberware for 60 seconds.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.cyberware-m: Disables one eligible piece of cyberware and its attached options for 60 seconds.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.lure: Creates a phantom noise that draws the target's next Move Action toward it.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.slow: Reduces the target's MOVE by 1d6 for 60 seconds.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.synapse-bur: Deals 3d6 damage directly to HP, ignoring armor.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Damage.Unauthorized: You are not authorized to roll damage for {actor}.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Damage.Invalid: This Quickhack damage roll is no longer valid.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.puppet: Controls the target's Action and Move Action during their next Turn.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.shard-eject: Ejects one installed piece of the target's chipware unless its slot is covered.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Item.Effect.system-rese: Leaves the target Unconscious and Prone for 60 seconds; damage can wake them early.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Quickhack.SelectionNote: This phase resolves the Interface Check and target alert. Mechanical effects will be automated in the next phase.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Quickhack.NoOwnedQuickh: {actor} does not possess any Quickhack Items.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Settings.RequireOwnedQu: When enabled, a Netrunner can select only Quickhack Items present in their character inventory. Items do not need to be equipped.

PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Settings.NpcToPlayer.Qu: The Quickhack attack roll is always GM-blind. The result always shows the Interface total, and the player becomes aware of the attack.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Settings.PlayerToNpc.Ja: The attack roll is always public. Choose who sees whether the NPC becomes aware.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Settings.PlayerToNpc.Qu: The attack roll and result are always public.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Settings.PlayerToPlayer: All Jack-In and Quickhack rolls and results are public.

PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.impair-m: Reduce the target's MOVE by 1 for 60 seconds; restore it manually.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.sonic-sh: Damaged Ear added without injury damage; remove it when the effect ends.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.overheat: Use the accompanying 4-damage card after each target turn until the fire is extinguished.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.short-ci: Choose three eligible cyberware components; disable them for 60 seconds.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.cyberwar: Choose one cyberware component; disable it and its options for 60 seconds.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.lure: Redirect the target's next Move toward a false sound.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.slow: Reduce MOVE by {amount} for 60 seconds; restore it manually.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.synapse-: Roll 3d6 from the attack card; apply it directly to HP without armor.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.puppet: Direct the target's next Action and Move using their own capabilities.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.shard-ej: Choose installed chipware and eject it nearby unless the slot is protected.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Summary.system-r: Native Unconscious and Prone statuses applied; remove them manually.
Apply Unconscious and Prone manually, then remove them when appropriate.
